subject: financial_literacy
concept: Applying stock ownership, diversification, compound growth, risk, and nest-egg building to a real-world long-term plan, using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student builds a simple long-term simulated investment plan, choosing a diversified set of holdings and a consistent contribution amount
exercise.pictorial: Student illustrates their plan's projected growth over simulated time
exercise.abstract: Student explains their plan's reasoning, referencing diversification and consistency

assessment.mastery_threshold: plan reflects genuine diversification and a consistent, realistic contribution approach
misconception_flags: plan puts all simulated money into a single holding despite the unit's diversification lesson

interest_binding: scenario generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
